get.summary:
Retrieves surgical appointments that match the supplied filters. Every filter is optional and may be combined; when none is provided, all appointments are returned.

**Detail collections** — `additionalProcedures`, `additionalMaterials`, `opsm`, `equipments`, `bloodComponents` and `codelessItems` — are intentionally **omitted** from this endpoint. They are heavier to resolve, so for the sake of list performance they are only materialized on demand.

To obtain those collections, fetch a single appointment through `GET /api/v2/surgical-schedules/appointments/{appointmentId}`, which returns the fully enriched representation.
